upstream.scope: Server-owned meter layout for the system summary (D1 §§7.4, 10-12; D2 T16, T28): six meter families (CPU, memory, swap, load, uptime, processes) placed in two semantic groups or hidden, bar or text presentation for CPU, memory and swap, hide/show of every meter, standard Button controls, the layout saved in a saved view through a version 3 settings format with migration; structure changes only on a layout change (MOVE_NODE, never a create or delete, because node IDs are never reused), per-sample updates scalar and only on shown meters; no geometry, window dimension or theme from the server; the CPU meter is one aggregate whatever the CPU count; no protocol, registry, SDK, runtime, client or dependency change; per-CPU meters and graphs out of scope (PX-052, PX-071-PX-073)

entries.feature: A MeterLayout places each of the six meters at most once in one of two semantic groups, or hides it, shows CPU, memory and swap as a bar beside their line or as the line alone (every meter has a text presentation), and can hide every meter; the default is every meter in group 1, bars for CPU, memory and swap; moving crosses the group boundary at the ends; every control that could change nothing is disabled and refused by event validation; every reachable layout publishes exactly the summary's 18 nodes and a status of at most 256 bytes
entries.scope: PX-070/meters (src/meters.rs) Meter, Presentation, MeterLayout, MeterAction, METER_BUTTONS, create_control_operations, control_operations; src/lib.rs METER_* node constants 108-132, install_meter_handlers; src/meters.rs unit tests; tests/meters_test.rs an_unchanged_layout_commits_nothing_and_a_disabled_control_is_refused

entries.feature: Structure changes only when the layout changes: a sample sets or clears properties only, and only on meters that are shown (a hidden meter, a bar shown as text and every meter while the meters are hidden keep what the client holds); a layout change is one transaction of MOVE_NODEs (at most one per click, two to hide a meter shown as text) plus group visibility, control labels and the figures of a meter shown again, carrying no figure a client already shows; no node is created or deleted after the shell (§6.2 IDs are never reused); an unchanged layout commits nothing; every revision is accepted by a client replica
entries.scope: PX-070/meters transition, arrangement, updates, properties; src/refresh.rs ProcessView::set_meter_layout, click_meter, laid_out; tests/meters_test.rs per_sample_updates_are_scalar_and_each_layout_change_is_structural_exactly_once; src/meters.rs the_moves_between_any_two_layouts_reach_the_target_and_a_click_moves_one_node, the_same_layout_sends_nothing_and_a_change_sends_no_figure

entries.feature: Unavailable, denied, unusable, not-provided, warming-up and interrupted figures never become a zero in either presentation: no bar carries a value, a bar-mode bar is hidden, and every line words the state with no digit; a failed scan keeps the last figures in text mode and the freshness line warns; a host listing 4, 256, 1024 or 65,536 logical CPUs, or an unknown count, publishes the same shell node count, a CPU line within its bound, the same row ceiling in every layout and a catch-up snapshot within one frame; the meter controls are charged a fixed 6 KiB reserve against the row ceiling and measured at their widest

The meter layout is a saved semantic preference: a saved view stores it in settings format version 3 (meters on|off and two meter-group lines of metric-id:bar|text entries, at most 32 entries per line), a restart restores it as structure, version 1 and 2 files migrate to the default layout and the next save writes version 3 with the older file kept as the backup; unknown meters and duplicates are dropped and an unsupported presentation becomes text, each explained, while malformed structure refuses the file; every PX-069 property holds after the bump (newer version and unknown first-line shape never interpreted or overwritten, checksum, bounds, backup protection); no geometry, window dimension, colour or figure is stored or sent

entries.feature: The unchanged generic AppKit client over real SSH renders the layout natively: samples update the meter views in place with every handle retained; a layout click moves the native view into group 2, puts the CPU bar into the collapsed container leaving its text line, hides both groups and restores the default; a native window resize and a dark/light appearance change send no event and rebuild no meter view; the PX-008 audit admits the 23 meter layout buttons with ACTIVATE only
